component.name: AppTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "runTask" m.port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("control", m.port) end sub
sub runTask() m.agent = CreateObject("roSGNode", "AgentNode") m.agent.callFunc("agentInit") ' same-thread call: this task calling its own local node.
m.global.addField("nrAgent", "node", false) m.global.nrAgent = m.agent
m.top.ready = true for i = 0 to 200 msg = wait(50, m.port) end for end sub
